events.title: NVIDIA Announces CEO Transition
events.facts: Issuer announced Jensen Huang resigned as president, CEO and director effective immediately; Colette Kress became interim CEO while retaining CFO duties; Harvey C. Jones became board chair.

events.note: No cause or future financial effect inferred.

events.source_locator: Official release, date and opening paragraph
